title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Classifications - Classifications
description: A single code value within one of the FEDeRATED Classifications ontology's controlled vocabularies -- document types, cargo/container/package/equipment types, dangerous goods and nature-of-cargo codes, transport modality and movement types, seal condition codes, TEN-T core network corridor names, etc. (classifications:Classifications and its ~14 subclasses). Modeled generically -- see the classificationScheme property -- rather than as one entity type per subclass, since the source ontology is a codelist/taxonomy, not a set of independently-structured entity types.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Classifications'. Name preserved verbatim from the base ontology's own root class (rdfs:label 'Classifications', plural).

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Human-readable label (rdfs:label in the source, where declared -- not every individual has one).

description.description: Property. rdfs:comment in the source, where declared.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

code.description: Property. The code value's own identifier within its scheme (e.g. 'CMR', 'BILL_OF_LADING', 'bulk'). Not a literal property declared in the source ontology -- each code value is represented there purely as a NamedIndividual's fragment identifier; this candidate exposes that identifier as a `code` property, mapped in context.jsonld to the standard SKOS skos:notation term (a deliberate modeling choice, not an asserted source term).

classificationScheme.description: Relationship. The specific Classifications subclass (scheme) this code value belongs to, e.g. https://ontology.tno.nl/logistics/federated/Classifications#DocumentType or .../Classifications#TransportModality. Mapped to rdf:type in context.jsonld, the same technique this repository's brick-schema candidate uses for brickClass.

transportMovementCode.description: Property. classifications:transportMovementCode. The code of the transport movement code. Declared with domain TransportMovementType in the source ontology -- applicable only when classificationScheme is TransportMovementType.

transportMovementID.description: Property. classifications:transportMovementID. The ID of the transport movement type. Declared with domain TransportMovementType in the source ontology -- applicable only when classificationScheme is TransportMovementType.
